craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-adbhuta of reductio pressed to the turn — vitarka as each escape collapses into consequence. Īśvara-turn begun; unless-One-keeps-apart hinge; siddhāntin-voiced per UNC. Rejected: (a) objector voice → killed: turn is ours. Read aloud: ONE-light WOULD-mix … THE-turn be-GUN.

lines: One light would mix all separate shinings into one,
unless some One, in all undivided, keeps each apart — the turn begun.

reads_against.argmap: One light — whose divisions? → The escape becomes the Īśvara-turn (prose: tatsa eveśvaro'stu).
c1_essence: Unperceived buddhi grounds no purpose; generic will forces omniscience on each; perception-by-all mixes appearances unless One holds them (vv37-41).
Nature's kit needs no purpose and purpose is courtesy-speech — yet the root-cause would never cease, so no liberation without a perceiving maker (vv42-45).
